from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single legal case document extracted from the collection."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document as written")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_form: str | None = Field(description="The legal form of the document, e.g. '判决书', '裁定书'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_records: list[CaseRecord]
